title: Suganob grateful for GAB 'Boxer of the Month' recognition

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines —Boholano boxing champion Regie “The Filipino Phenom” Suganob expressed gratitude to the Games and Amusements Board (GAB) after being named its Boxer of the Month for September, saying the recognition belongs to the team and supporters who have stood by him throughout his career. “I am deeply honored by the Games and Amusements Board (GAB) for naming me their Boxer of the Month. This recognition belongs to my team and everyone who continues to believe in me. The hard work doesn’t stop here,” Suganob said in a statement.
